sections.title: Deploy future-ready meeting spaces with ease
sections.text:

contact@avispl.com avispl.com
DEPLOY FUTURE-READY
MEETING SPACES WITH EASE
Simplify conference room setup with tech bundles
Many IT teams face mounting pressure to modernize meeting spaces while balancing time, budget, and user
expectations. Managing multiple vendors, complex room designs, and inconsistent experiences can slow down
deployment and frustrate employees. The result? Delayed rollouts, increased support tickets, and reduced productivity.
Avoid the complexity of conference room design and deployment. This secure and user-friendly Microsoft Teams
Rooms solution, featuring LG, Jabra, and Salamander, gets your spaces up and running quickly so teams can connect
without disruption.
READY-TO-DEPLOY COLLABORATION SPACES
Organizations no longer need to piece together multiple technologies to create a functional meeting room. This bundled
solution combines Microsoft Teams, LG, and Jabra into one seamless experience. Whether you are equipping a small
huddle room or a larger conference space, you can select the Jabra PanaCast 50 MTR, a Salamander Acadia Tabletop
Stand, and the LG display size that best fits your space: 43, 50, or 65 inches. With installation and setup in under 90
minutes, IT can give employees instant access to collaboration spaces that simply work.
Start transforming your spaces with the LG Express Microsoft Teams Room Solution

<!-- page 2 -->
contact@avispl.com avispl.com
STREAMLINE DESIGN AND STANDARDIZE EVERY ROOM
IT leaders often struggle with the burden of multiple vendors, complex designs, and inconsistent user experiences. This
solution removes that friction by standardizing the layout, features, and functionality across rooms. With a consistent
design, IT can deploy quickly, reduce support needs, and provide employees with the confidence that every meeting
space will deliver the same high-quality experience.
Simplify your collaboration rollout
SCALE WITH AVI-SPL EXPERT SUPPORT
The true value of a solution is in its ability to scale. AVI-SPL brings global expertise and long-standing partnerships
with LG, Microsoft, Jabra, and Salamander to ensure consistent deployment across the enterprise. Our teams can
tailor solutions to fit the unique needs of each location and provide flexible support that grows with your organization.
Whether deploying a single Microsoft Teams Room or expanding to hundreds, AVI-SPL ensures every space is ready for
the future of work.
